headline: Sub-category with the largest total loss
question: Which sub-category loses the most money?

approach: Rank sub-categories from lowest total profit.
Return every sub-category tied for the largest loss.
report.headline: Sub-category with the largest total loss
report.intent: You want to identify the sub-category with the most negative total profit.
report.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT sub_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(profit) ASC) AS rnk FROM orders GROUP BY sub_category) SELECT sub_category FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1
